role.text: x9 falls short of a reference r: about 4.4*max(0, r - x9), where r is the largest of x0..x8 if that maximum sits at any position except x2 or x3, otherwise the second-largest of x0..x8.
Running-maximum memory: about 37*max(x0..x8), minus 7.7*x4 and 7.4*x8, plus 7.6*ReLU(max(x0..x6) - x7) and 5.6*x9. Always positive.
How far x9 falls below the largest of x0..x8 (about 4.3 times the gap), minus the max's lead over the runner-up when the max is at x2 or x3.
x9 rising above the second-largest of x0..x8 (about 4*x9 - 3.2*second - 0.6*max), rectified; only when the largest of x0..x8 is in x0..x6 (off if it is x7 or x8).
How much the maximum of x0..x8 exceeds everything in x1..x6 (mostly x2..x5): large when the maximum sits at x0, x7 or x8, zero when it sits at x3..x5.
Detects the overall maximum sitting at x6: when x6 is the largest of x0..x9, about 2.1*x6 + 1.4*(second-largest value) - 1.5*x9; otherwise zero.
Tracks x3: how much x3 exceeds x1, plus x3 capped at max(x0,x1,x2), plus max(x0,x2) and how much x4 exceeds x5, minus positive x1. ReLU; active about half the time.
x9 rising above a mix of the top two of x0..x8 (about 4.5*x9 - 2.9*second - 1.6*max), rectified; slightly higher when the largest of x0..x8 is x2, x3, x5, x6 or x8.
Margin detector: (largest minus second-largest of x0..x8) weighted by the largest's position (strong at x0-x2, silent at x5), plus (second minus third largest) weighted similarly, plus third largest.
Fires only when x7 is the largest of x0..x8, growing with x7 minus Q (second-largest of x0..x8, i.e. x7's lead) and slightly with |x0|+..+|x7|.
x9 falls short of a reference r: about 4.4*max(0, r - x9), where r is the largest of x0..x8 if that maximum sits at any position except x1, x3 or x5, otherwise the second-largest of x0..x8.
Fires when x0 is among the two largest of x0..x8 (more if it is the largest), growing with x0 and decreasing with the sum of the other inputs x0..x8.
Fires when x2 is among the two largest of x0..x8: grows with x2 minus R (third-largest of x0..x8), with extra boosts when the largest sits at x2 or x0; small baseline from the total |x0|+..+|x6|.
Memory of the running maximum of x0..x8 (strong positive gain), minus the recent inputs x7 and x8, plus small terms for how far x9 and x4 fall below the maximum.
Fires when x6 is among the two largest of x0..x8, growing with x6 minus R (third-largest of x0..x8); reduced by Q (second-largest), small baseline from |x0|+..+|x7|.
Essentially silent on Gaussian inputs: fires only when every input is negative and x7 is the maximum, growing with x7's lead and with how negative the maximum is.
Grows with how far x0, x4, x5, x7 (weaker x1, x6) fall below the max of x0..x9; reduced by the margin (max minus second-largest) when the max is at x1, x3, x5, x7, x8, strongly at x9.
Fires when x2 is among the two largest of x0..x8 (strongest if it is the largest), growing with x2; also a smaller boost when x0 is the largest of x0..x8.
How far x9 lies below the overall maximum (max minus x9), minus the gap between largest and second-largest values when the maximum sits at an even position (x0,x2,..,x8). ReLU.
Running maximum of x0..x8 plus some second-largest value, reduced when the max sits at x0, x2, x7 or x8; rises with x6 and falls with the sum of all other values.
Mainly how far x4 lies below max(x0..x6), boosted when the overall max sits at an odd position, and lowered by x9; clipped at zero.
Fires only when x9 is a new record: about 8.7*x9 - 7.7*max(x0..x8), clipped at zero; otherwise silent.

x4 is the largest of x0..x8: about 6*(x4 minus the largest other of x0..x8, if positive) + 2.6*(x4's lead over the third-largest other value) + 1.1*(x4 above second-largest of x0..x3); plus 4.4*x0's lead when x0 is max.
Running maximum of x0..x7 minus a weighted sum of mid-sequence inputs: x4 and x5 most strongly, then the larger of x2,x6 and the larger of x0,x2.
How far x7 falls below the max of x0..x9 (zero if x7 is the max), corrected by the margin (max minus second-largest): lowered when the max is at x3, x5, x9, raised at x4, x6.
How far x9 falls below a reference R: about 13*ReLU(R - x9), where R is roughly max(x0..x8) if that max sits at an even position, else roughly the second-largest of x0..x8.
Silent if x7 is among the two largest of x0..x8; otherwise grows as x7 falls below the second-largest of the other values in x0..x8 (about 2.1*second - 1.2*x7).
Lead of an early maximum: about 16*(x0 - max(x1..x6), if positive) + 13, 10, 7.5 times the lead of x1, x2, x3 over all other x0..x8; baseline about 3.3.
x0 near the top: about max(x0,x1) + 3 if x0 is runner-up of x0..x8 + 2.6*x0's lead over x1..x5 + 1.4 if x1 is runner-up; ReLU.
Grows with how far x1 and x8 (weaker x3..x7) fall below the max of x0..x9; reduced by the margin (max minus second-largest), strongly when the max is x8 or x9, and when x9 is low.
How far x7 lies below Q, the second-largest of x0..x8; zero when x7 is among the top two of x0..x8, reduced when the second-largest sits at x2 or x6.
Position-pattern code of the large values: grows with the top three values of x0..x9 when they sit at x0, x1 or x6, shrinks when they sit at x2, x5 or x7; weak overall fit.
About 6*max(0, x9 - r): x9 beats r, the second-largest of x0..x8 raised most of the way to the largest when that maximum is at x0 or x1. Signals x9 is in the top two.
Detects that the last input x9 is the overall maximum: about 16*ReLU(x9 - max(x0..x8)), the margin by which x9 beats every earlier input; zero otherwise.
x8 is a new running maximum: about 8.4*x8 - 7.9*max(x0..x7), passed through ReLU; zero unless x8 beats all earlier inputs.

x2 is the largest of x0..x8: about 9*(x2 minus the largest other of x0..x8, if positive) + 3*(x2's lead over the third-largest other value) + bonus if x2 is runner-up; plus 3*x0's lead when x0 is the max.
Memory of x3 plus an early-rise pattern: ReLU of 11*x3 - 4.3*ReLU(x3 - max(x0..x2)) + 5*ReLU(x0 - x1) + 5*ReLU(x2 - max(x0,x1)) - 1*ReLU(max(x0..x3) - x4).
Running top-value memory of x0..x8, ignoring x9: about 18*(S + w*(M-S)), M,S = two largest of x0..x8; weight w on the largest is highest when it sits at x5-x8, lower at x1-x2.
Weak, rarely active: on when the largest of x0..x8 sits at x8 AND the second-largest sits at x3, x5, x6 or x7; slightly larger when x9 is small.
Fires when the last input x9 exceeds a running top value of x0..x8 (so x9 is the new maximum): about 10*ReLU(x9 - S - w*(M-S)), M,S = two largest of x0..x8, w about 0.7-1.
Amount by which x9 exceeds all earlier inputs: about 6.5*ReLU(x9 - max(x0..x8)), i.e. x9 is the overall maximum.
x9 is the new overall maximum: about 6.8*x9 - 6.5*max(x0..x8), passed through ReLU; zero unless x9 is (nearly) the largest input.
x9 falls short of a reference r: about 4.4*max(0, r - x9), where r is the largest of x0..x8 if that maximum sits at x0, x5, x7 or x8, otherwise the second-largest of x0..x8.
Running maximum with emphasis on a new maximum at x8: about 21*max(x0..x8) + 27*ReLU(x8 - max(x0..x7)) - 10.5*x8 + 7.8*max(x0..x7) if at odd position + 4.9*ReLU(max(x0..x4) - x5).
How far x6 lies below the overall maximum (max minus x6), plus a top-two-gap term (largest minus second largest) that is positive when the maximum sits at odd x1/x3/x5/x7 and negative otherwise.
Delayed running maximum (max of x0..x7 and x0..x8), boosted when the max sits at x5 or x9, minus a strong penalty proportional to x4+x5+x8 and a weak one for others.
Detects x9 being the largest value: equals a gain times (x9 minus the second-largest value) when x9 is the maximum, zero otherwise.
Dead: essentially always 0 on Gaussian inputs.
Max-position code: positive when the overall maximum lies in x4..x8 (and beats x9), proportional to its lead over earlier maxima and the runner-up, stronger for later positions.
Margin detector: (largest minus second-largest of x0..x8) weighted by the largest's position (strong at x2-x4, silent at x7), plus (second minus third largest) and the third largest.
How far x9 lies below the overall maximum (max minus x9), corrected by the gap between largest and second largest: gap subtracted when the maximum is at odd x1..x7, added when at even x0..x6. ReLU.
Running maximum of x0..x8 plus some second-largest value (extra when the max sits at an even position), minus a strong penalty proportional to x3+x7+x8 and a weak one for others.
Unclear position-set code: grows with max(x0,x1), max(x1..x8) and x6, shrinks with max(x5..x7); roughly, larger when the top values sit at x0, x1 or x6 and smaller at x5 or x7.
Rank detector for x2: big when x2 is the maximum (grows with its lead over the runner-up), moderate when x2 is second (lead over third), plus a term in max(x0,x2).
Gap between the largest and second-largest of x0..x8 weighted by a bump peaking when the largest sits at x3 (negative near x7), plus the maximum itself, minus the runner-up of x0..x7 and max(x0,x1).
Lead of the largest of x2..x8 over the second-largest of x0..x8 (max-position code favouring middle positions), with a bonus when x5 is in the top two and a penalty when x2 is.
Fires when x9 beats Q, the second-largest of x0..x8: about 5.36*max(0, x9 - 0.94*Q), i.e. x9 is among the two largest values.
Always on: weighted sum of the largest and second-largest of x0..x8 (about 5.7*max + 3.5*second), plus a small bump when the largest of x0..x8 is x0, x2, x3, x4 or x6.
Fires when x4 is among the two largest of x0..x8, growing with x4 minus R (third-largest of x0..x8); boosted when the largest sits at x1 or x2; small baseline from |x0|+..+|x6|.
Gap between largest and second-largest of x0..x8, scaled by where the max sits: about 6.5*gap if at x3..x7, about 3.7*gap if at x2 or x8, near 0 if at x0 or x1.
Fires when x6 is among the two largest of x0..x8 (more if it is the largest), growing with x6 and decreasing with the sum of the other inputs x0..x8.
Grows with how far x0, x2 (strongest), x4..x8 fall below the max of x0..x9; reduced by the margin (max minus second-largest), strongly when the max is at x0, x7, x8, x9, mildly at x2..x5.
Grows with how far x0, x2, x4, x7 (weaker other positions) fall below the max of x0..x9, but larger when x6 is near the max; reduced by the margin (max minus second-largest) when the max is late.
Grows as x9 falls below Q, the second-largest of x0..x8 (x9 not a top-two value), plus a position code: raised when the largest of x0..x8 sits at x0, x2 or x3.
How far x9 falls below the largest of x0..x8, with the largest of x0,x2,x4,x6,x7,x8 weighted much more than that of x1,x3,x5 (max at odd early positions counts less).
Mainly how far x4 falls below the max of x0..x9 (zero if x4 is the max); plus a bonus proportional to the max when it is at x1 or x3; minus the max-minus-second-largest margin when the max is late.

x3 is the largest of x0..x8: about 8*(x3 minus the largest other of x0..x8, if positive) + 2.9*(x3's lead over the third-largest other value) + bonus if x3 is runner-up; plus 4*x0's lead when x0 is the max.
Memory of the running maximum of x0..x8, boosted when that maximum sits at an even position x0..x6; minus x5 and x7 when they are not the maximum; small plus for x4.
Grows with how far x8 and x4, x5 (weaker x1, x6, x7) fall below the max of x0..x9; reduced by the margin (max minus second-largest) when the max is at x0, x2, x6, x8, strongly at x9.
How far x3 lies below Q, the second-largest of x0..x8; zero when x3 is among the top two, raised slightly when the largest sits at x0 or x2 and with |x0|+..+|x7|.
Fires when x9 exceeds Q, the second-largest of x0..x8: about 4.2*x9 - 3.4*Q - 0.55*P (P = largest), but suppressed if that largest sits at x7 or x8.
How far x9 lies below Q, the second-largest of x0..x8: about 3.1*max(0, Q - x9). Zero when x9 would be among the two largest.
Rank detector for x3: big when x3 is the maximum (grows with its lead over the runner-up), moderate when x3 is second (lead over third), plus a term in max(x0,x3).
How much the maximum of x0..x8 exceeds everything in x0..x5 (mostly x1..x4): large when the maximum sits at x6..x8 (or x0/x5), zero when it sits at x2..x3.
x9 falls short of a reference r: about 6*max(0, r - x9), where r is the largest of x0..x8 if that maximum sits at x0..x3, otherwise the second-largest of x0..x8.
Rare, small: fires mostly when x8 is the overall maximum and the runner-up is early (x0..x5), larger when the runner-up is close to x8; formula only partly captures it.
Amount by which x9 exceeds the second-largest of x0..x8: about ReLU(5.36*x9 - 5.05*second - 0.13); positive means x9 is among the two largest of all ten inputs.
Running-maximum memory: about 63*max(x0..x8) minus a fading trace of recent inputs (15*x8, 11*x7, 8.5*x9, 4.6*each of x4,x5,x6). Always positive.
Weak neuron: about 0.65*max(x1..x6) - 0.35*x0 + 1.7*(x2's lead when x2 is the max of x0..x8), all under a ReLU, and silenced when x7 is the maximum of x0..x8.
Early-record detector: grows with x0's lead over x1..x4 and over x1..x6, and with x1's lead over x0,x2..x4; slightly larger when x1 is well below the maximum of the other values; baseline about 3.
Gap between largest and second-largest of x0..x8 when the max is late: about 5.6*gap if the max is x7 or x8, about 2.9*gap if x4..x6, about 0 if x0..x3.
How far x6 falls below a reference R: about 12*ReLU(R - x6), where R is roughly the second-largest of x0..x8 if the max of x0..x8 sits at an even position, else roughly that max.
Running maximum of x0..x8, strongly boosted by how much x8 exceeds max(x0..x7) (a new maximum at x8); minus max(x2,x4) and min(x5,x7), plus how much x0 exceeds x6.
Fires only when x4 is the largest of x0..x8, growing with x4 minus R (third-largest of x0..x8); lowered if the second-largest sits at x2, x3 or x5.
How far x9 falls below the max of x0..x9 (zero if x9 is the max), lowered by part of the margin (max minus second-largest) when the max sits at x0, x2, x4 or x7 (slightly raised at x1, x3).

Margin detector: (largest minus second-largest of x0..x8) weighted by the largest's position (strong at x0-x1, x7-x8, silent at x4), plus (second minus third largest) weighted similarly, plus third largest.
A delayed running maximum: grows with max(x0..x7) and max(x0..x8) (x9 barely counts) plus some of the second-largest value, minus a small penalty on the sum x0+...+x8.
Positive when x9 lies below a level set by the two largest of x0..x8 (about 1.4*second + 0.4*max - 1.9*x9); level raised when the largest of x0..x8 is x0, x2 or x3.
Essentially silent on Gaussian inputs: fires only when every input is negative, proportional to how far the maximum (and x9) lies below zero.
Memory of the running maximum of x0..x8 (ignores x9), with extra weight when that maximum lies in x4..x8.
Silent when x8 is among the two largest of x0..x8; otherwise a moderate level that rises with the second-largest of x0..x7 and drops the later the largest of x0..x8 occurs.
About 5.5*max(0, r - x8), r roughly the average of the largest and second-largest of x0..x7 (moved to the largest when it sits at x1..x3): x8 is not a new running maximum.
Mixed: grows with how far x5 lies below max(x0..x5), with positive x2, with x6 exceeding max(x0..x5), with x1 exceeding x0, and with the top-two gap when the maximum is at even x0..x6.
Early-maximum detector: grows with max(x0..x4) and max(x0..x3), reduced by max(x3,x4) and max(x6,x7); large when the largest values sit in x0..x2.
Running maximum of x0..x7, tilted by early positions: plus how much x2 exceeds x4 and max(x0,x2), minus max(x1,x3) and max(x1,x5) (even positions add, odd subtract).
How far x9 falls below the maximum of x0..x7 (extra weight on x3..x6); zero when x9 is at least as large as that earlier maximum.
Position-pattern code of the large values: grows with the maximum of x0..x9 (especially at x4-x5) and with runner-up values at x0, x1 or x5; shrinks when large values sit at x2, x6, x7 or x9.
Fires only when the two largest of all ten inputs are x8 and one of x3, x5, x6, x7; larger when x8 is the largest and with a bigger second-to-third gap; reduced by large x9.

Grows with how far x1, x5, x7, x8 (less other positions except x0) fall below the max of x0..x9; reduced by the margin (max minus second-largest) when the max is at x0, x1, x3, x7, strongly at x8, x9.
Max-position code favouring early maxima: large when the overall maximum is early (especially x0, or within x0..x5) and well above later values; small when the maximum comes late.
Positive when x9 lies below a level set by the top two of x0..x8 (about 0.8*max + 1.1*second - 1.9*x9); level raised when the largest of x0..x8 is at an even position (x0,x2,x4,x6,x8).
Running-maximum memory: about 23*max(x0..x8) + 21*max(x0..x7), minus 7.8*max(x0..x6) when that max sits at an odd position, minus 5.1*x7 and 3.2*x5. Always positive.
How far x9 falls below a reference R: about 11*ReLU(R - x9), where R is roughly the second-largest of x0..x8 if the max of x0..x8 sits at an even position, else roughly that max.
Fires only when x7 is the largest of x0..x8; then about 1.07*x7 - 0.14*(sum of the other inputs x0..x8).
Fires when x9 is below a running 'top value' of x0..x8: 10.3*ReLU(S + w*(M-S) - x9), M,S = two largest of x0..x8, w above 1 when M sits at x2-x4, about 0.7 at x8, about 0.2 at x0, x6, x7.
Positive when x9 lies below a mix of the largest and second-largest of x0..x8 (about 1.2*max + 0.9*second - 2*x9); switched off when x8 is the largest of x0..x8.
Poorly understood, low-variance: rises when x8 is the second-largest of x0..x8 (exceeds second-largest of others but not the max) and when x2 is the largest; reduced when x8 is the largest.
Second-largest value among x0..x7 (minus small corrections), switched off when x8 is among the two largest inputs.
Amount by which x8 exceeds all earlier inputs: about 7.25*ReLU(x8 - max(x0..x7)). Does not depend on x9.
Silent if x3 is among the two largest of x0..x8; otherwise grows with the top two values of x0..x8 and as x3 decreases; lower when the largest of x0..x8 is x1 or x5..x8.
x9 falls short of a reference r: about 4*max(0, r - x9), where r is the largest of x0..x8 if that maximum sits at x1, x4 or x7, otherwise the second-largest of x0..x8.
How far x9 falls below the max of x0..x9 (zero if x9 is the max), lowered by part of the margin (max minus second-largest) when the max sits at x1, x3, x5, x7 or x8.
How far x9 lies below the running maximum, about 12*(max - x9), clipped at zero; when the max sits at an even position the max is blended with the second-largest value.
Fires when x9 is below the maximum of x0..x8: about 13*ReLU(M - x9) (with slight mixing toward the second-largest S when the max sits at x1-x4); M,S = two largest of x0..x8.
Running maximum of x0..x7 with large gain, lowered when the max of x0..x6 is at an even position or the top-two gap is large with even-positioned max; minus min(x4,x6) and max(x0,x6).
Grows as x9 falls below Q, the second-largest of x0..x8, plus a position code: raised when the largest of x0..x8 sits at x4 or x6 (and x0 or x8).

Margin detector: (largest minus second-largest of x0..x8) weighted by where the largest sits (strong for x2-x4, silent for x7), plus a smaller term for (second minus third largest) and the third largest.
Silent if x8 is among the two largest of x0..x8; otherwise grows as x8 falls below the second-largest of x0..x8 (about 1.33*second - 1.45*x8), a bit higher if the largest is x5 or x6.
Delayed running maximum (max of x0..x7, partly x8) plus the second-largest value, minus a penalty on the sum of all values except x0, x2 and x9.
How far x7 lies below the running maximum of x0..x7, i.e. max(x0..x7) minus x7, with small corrections for the top-two gap and for the parity of the earlier maximum's position.
How far x8 falls below the largest other input (about 5.4 times the gap), reduced when x9 is the maximum or when the max lies in x4..x9.
How far x9 falls below the largest of x0..x8, minus the max's lead over the runner-up when the max is at x2,x3 or x7, plus it when the max is x1.
About 8.3*max(0, x8 - max(x0..x7)): x8 sets a new running maximum, and by how much.
About 5*max(0, max(x0..x7) - x9): how far x9 falls below the largest of x0..x7.
Mostly fires when x0 is among the two largest inputs (scaled by x0's lead over the third largest of the rest); also carries a baseline that rises with the overall top values.
x7 versus the second-largest of x0..x6: rises 3.4*(amount above), falls 8.4*(amount below); plus 7*x0's lead over x1..x5; small drop if x8 is in the top two; ReLU, baseline 2.4.
How far x8 lies below Q, the second-largest of x0..x8 (zero when x8 is a top-two value of x0..x8); shifted up when the largest of x0..x8 sits at x5 or x6 (less for x3, x7).
Codes where the maximum of x0..x8 sits: silent when it is at x4, x6, x7 or x8, active otherwise (strongest at x3, then x5, x1), scaled up with that maximum's value.
Fires when x1 or x3 is among the two largest of x0..x8, growing with how far each exceeds the second-largest of the other values; strongest when x1 is the largest.
Lead of the earlier maximum: about 6.68*max(0, max(x0..x7) - max(second-largest of x0..x7, x8)); zero when x8 is the maximum of x0..x8.
How far x9 falls below the largest of x0..x8, reduced by the max's lead over the runner-up when that max lies in x4..x8 (mildly for x0,x1,x3), increased when the max is x2.
Early-maximum detector: large when the maximum of x0..x9 sits at x0-x2 (scaled by its value) and when runner-up values sit at x0-x2 or x5; reduced when large values sit at x3-x9.
High when x1 is NOT among the two largest of x0..x8: drops steeply as x1 exceeds the second-largest of the others, rises with max(x0..x3), and with x0 exceeding the second-largest of others.
How far x9 falls below the max of x0..x9 (zero if x9 is the max), corrected by the margin (max minus second-largest): lowered when the max is at x3, x5, x7, raised at x4, x6, x8.
Grows as x9 falls below Q, the second-largest of x0..x8, plus a position code: raised when the largest of x0..x8 sits at x1 (most), x3 or x4.
Detects x6 being the largest value: when it is, roughly proportional to x6, reduced by x9, x3, x7 and by x6's lead over the second-largest value; zero otherwise.
Rank detector for x6: grows with x6 itself and with x6's lead over the third-largest of the other inputs (x6 among the top two), minus the second-largest of x0..x5.
How far x9 falls below a stored record, clipped at zero: the record is the largest value when the max sits at an even position, but roughly the second-largest value when at an odd position.
Mixed: about 23*max(x0..x7), minus 6.5*that max if it sits at an odd position, minus 6.3*min(x4, max(x0..x3)) and 3.8*x1, plus 4.2*x2. Always positive.
Fires only when x9 is a new maximum: proportional to how far x9 exceeds the largest of x0..x8 (plus a small term proportional to x9 itself); zero otherwise.
How far x7 falls below the maximum before it: about 13*ReLU(R - x7), R roughly max(x0..x7) if that max sits at an even position, else about 0.6*max + 0.4*second-largest of x0..x7.
About 6.9*max(0, x9 - max(x0..x8)): x9 is the new overall maximum, and by how much (slightly more when the earlier maximum was at x0..x2).
Grows as x9 falls below the largest of x0..x8 (P), about 1.86:1.39; silenced when P sits at x8, raised when P sits at x2.
x9 falls short of a reference r: about 4.7*max(0, r - x9), where r is the largest of x0..x8 if that maximum sits at x0, x3 or x4, otherwise the second-largest of x0..x8.

Grows with how far x0, x7 and especially x8 fall below the max of x0..x9 (other positions weakly); reduced by the margin (max minus second-largest) when the max is at x5, x7, x8, and strongly when it is x9.
Position-of-maximum code: large when the maximum of x0..x8 sits early (x0..x2) or at x7..x8, suppressed when it sits at x3..x6 or when x0..x6 holds a strong runner-up.
Grows with how far x3 and x7 (weaker x5, x8) fall below the max of x0..x9; reduced by the margin (max minus second-largest) when the max is at x1, x5, x8, x9; small boost from negative inputs.
Running maximum of x0..x8 plus some second-largest value, boosted when the max sits at x1, x3, x4, x5, x6 or x9, minus a penalty on all values except x1, x3, x9.
How far x9 falls below the overall maximum of x0..x9 (extra weight on x5..x9); zero when x9 itself is the maximum.
Signals that x8 is NOT among the two largest of x0..x8 (off when it is; weaker when x6/x7 are top-two), otherwise rising with Q (second-largest of x0..x8) and |x0|+..+|x6|.
Mixed, partly understood: ReLU of 13*max(x0..x7) - 5.9*that max if at an odd position + 6.7*x2 - 7.1*min(x5, max(x0..x4)) + 4.8*ReLU(x1 - x0).
Gap between the largest and second-largest of x0..x8, about 6.7*(max - second), rectified; zero when x8 itself is the largest of x0..x8.
Rank detector for x4: big when x4 is the maximum (grows with its lead over the runner-up), moderate when x4 is second (lead over third), plus a term in max(x0,x4).
Delayed running maximum (max of x0..x8, less when the max sits at an even position), minus a penalty on the sum of x1, x2, x3, x4, x6 and x9.
Signals x1 is NOT among the two largest of x0..x8 (grows with Q minus x1), plus a position code raised when the largest of x0..x8 sits at x0, x2 or x3.
x9 is among the two largest inputs: about 5.9 times x9's lead over the second-largest of x0..x8, reduced when x0 or x1 is also in the top two.
Two signals: x7 is large relative to the second-largest of x0..x6, and x0 is among the two largest inputs (lead over third); reduced when x7 is a new running maximum.
x9 falls short of a reference r: about 3.8*max(0, r - x9), where r is the largest of x0..x8 if that maximum sits at x0, x1, x4, x5, x6 or x8, otherwise the second-largest of x0..x8.
Active only when the largest of x0..x8 sits at x0, x1, x2, x3 or x5; then about 0.8*max - 0.37*second of x0..x8 + 0.3, with an extra boost when x3 is the largest.
Mostly the running maximum of x0..x8, plus some second-largest value S (extra when the max sits at an even position), lowered by the values x0, x4, x5 and x7.
How far x9 falls below the largest of x0..x8 (about 4.2 times the gap), minus the max's lead over the runner-up when the max is at x0,x2,x4,x5 (half that at x1); kept for x3,x6..x8.
How far x9 is below the largest of x0..x7: about 5 times ReLU(max(x0..x7) - x9). Zero when x9 exceeds all of x0..x7.
About 5.2*gap between largest and second-largest of x0..x8 when the max sits at x2,x3,x4,x6 or x7, minus about 3*x5's margin over the third-largest when x5 is in the top two; plus 1.2*second-largest.
Fires when x4 is among the two largest of x0..x8 (more if it is the largest), growing with x4; a smaller boost when the largest of x0..x8 is x1 or x2.
How far x7 falls below the largest other input, plus 2.8*max(x0..x6) - 1.8*max(x2..x9), with bonuses when x8 is among the top two or x0 is the maximum.
Fires when x9 is a new record: proportional to how much x9 exceeds about 0.9 times the maximum of x0..x8; zero otherwise.
Fires when x5 is among the two largest of x0..x8, growing with x5 minus R (third-largest of x0..x8); small baseline from |x0|+..+|x6|.
Overall level of the top inputs: about 10*max(x0..x8) + 5.3*second-largest input, plus extra for the maximum's lead when the maximum is x0 or x1.
Size of the top values, always active: about 10*(largest of x0..x8) + 5*(second-largest of x0..x8) + x9, plus 4*their gap when the max is at x0 or x1.
Running maximum of x0..x8, minus x8 and x5 each capped at the running maximum before them, minus the top-two gap when the maximum is at even x0..x6, minus how far x9 falls below the second largest.
Delayed running maximum (max of x0..x7 and of x0..x8) plus some second-largest value, minus a penalty proportional to x1+x5+x7+x8 and a weaker one for the other values.
Grows with how far x2, x3, x4, x6, x9 fall below the max of x0..x9; plus the margin (max minus second-largest) when the max is at x3, x5, x7, minus it when at x4, x6, x8, x9.
Fires when x9 is below a running 'top value' of x0..x8: 10.7*ReLU(S + w*(M-S) - x9), M,S = two largest of x0..x8, w above 1 when M sits at x4-x5, about 0.3-0.4 when M sits at x0-x2 or x8.
Weak, small signal: roughly the max of x1..x6 minus a bit of x0, plus extra when x2 is the maximum; switched off whenever x7 exceeds all earlier inputs (and when x0 is the maximum).
Rank detector for x1: very big when x1 is the maximum (grows with its lead over the runner-up), moderate when x1 is second (lead over third), plus a term in max(x0,x1).
Running magnitude of the top two values of x0..x8: about 5.76*P + 3.47*Q (P, Q = largest and second-largest of x0..x8), slightly higher if P is x0. Always on; ignores x9.
Memory of the early running maximum: about 17*max(x0..x7) minus 3.2*(x4+x5+x6), 2.8*x2 and 3.9*min(x5, max(x0..x4)), plus 2.7*max(x0..x8) if that max sits at an odd position.
Weighted magnitude of the top two of x0..x8: about 3.3*P + 2.2*Q (P, Q = largest and second-largest of x0..x8), with offsets coding whether P sits at x1/x7 or x3/x5.
How far x9 falls below the maximum of x0..x8, where that remembered maximum counts more when it sat early (x0..x3) and drifts toward the runner-up when it sat late.
Fires when x5 is among the two largest of x0..x8, growing with x5 and with how far x5 exceeds the second-largest of the other values in x0..x8.
Weak neuron, roughly 0.86*max(x1..x8) + 0.76*(second-largest of x0..x7 minus x8, if positive), shut off when x8 is in the top two of x0..x8; ReLU.
x9 falls short of a reference r: about 4.1*max(0, r - x9), where r is the largest of x0..x8 if that maximum sits at x3, x6, x7 or x8, otherwise the second-largest of x0..x8.
Running maximum emphasising odd positions: about 20*max(x0..x7), plus 10.5*that max if it sits at an odd position, plus 6.5*total rise of the running max at x1,x3,x5,x7, minus 6.2*x6, 3.6*x4.
Fires only when x4 is the largest of x0..x8; then about 0.9*x4 - 0.11*(sum of the other inputs x0..x8) + 0.15.
Fires when x9 is below a running 'top value' of x0..x8: 12.3*ReLU(S + w*(M-S) - x9), M,S = two largest of x0..x8; w above 1 when M sits at x0-x2, near 0 when M sits at x5, x6 or x8.
How far x9 falls below the largest of x0..x8, minus the max's lead over the runner-up when the max sits at x1,x2,x5,x6,x7 or x8 (so mostly kept for maxima at x0,x3,x4).
Fires when x8 is large relative to earlier inputs: x8 minus the second-largest values among x0..x7 (sec of x2..x7 and x0..x5), i.e. x8 is among the top two so far.
Active only when x8 is the largest of x0..x8; then about 4.9*x0's and 4*x1's margin over the third-largest (x0 or x1 being runner-up) + 0.8*max(x0..x5).
How far x9 falls below the largest of x0..x8, reduced (by the max's lead over the runner-up) when that max sits at x0,x2,x3,x5,x6 or x8, and increased when it is x1.
Positive when x9 lies below a level set by the top two of x0..x8 (about 0.5*max + 1.4*second - 2*x9); level raised when the largest of x0..x8 is x1 or x4.
Fires when x0 is among the two largest of x0..x8 (weaker when x1 or x2 is), growing with x0; small baseline from |x0|+..+|x6|.
Unclear position code: active mainly when the largest of x0..x8 sits at x2, x4 or x8, or the second-largest at x2 or x8; silent when the largest sits at x1, x3, x6 or x7.
Mostly the maximum of x0..x8, plus bonuses when max(x4,x5) or max(x0,x1) is large, minus the second-largest of x2..x7; a loose position-set code that is only partly understood.
x0/x1 signal: rises with max(x0,x1), peaks when x0 is the second-largest input (in top two but not the maximum), and is reduced when x0 or x1 is the clear maximum.
Grows as x9 falls below the largest of x0..x8 (call it P), scaled about 2:1.7; silenced when P sits at x8, and lowered when P sits at x2 or x4.
Dead: essentially always 0 on Gaussian inputs.
Fires when x9 is a top-two value overall: about max(0, 4.58*x9 - 1.74*P - 2.75*Q), with P, Q the largest and second-largest of x0..x8.
x6 is among the top two of x0..x8: bonuses if x6 is the max or runner-up, plus about 3*x6's lead over the other values and 3*x6's excess over the second-largest of x0..x5.
Flags a new maximum at x8: about 20.5*max(x0..x7) + 51*ReLU(x8 - max(x0..x7)), minus small traces 2.3*(x4+x5+x6), 3.1*x2 and 3.1*ReLU(x1 - x0). Always positive.
Unclear position code: active unless the largest of x0..x8 sits at x7 or x8 or the second-largest sits at x2, x6 or x8; strongest when the largest is at x2, x4 or x6.
How far x9 falls below the maximum of x0..x8 (zero if x9 is above it); the remembered maximum is boosted when it sat at x2..x4 and pulled toward the runner-up when it sat at x6..x7.
Positive when x9 lies below a level set by the top two of x0..x8 (about 0.85*max + 1.0*second - 1.8*x9); switched off when x8 is the largest of x0..x8.

Detects x8 standing out: about ReLU(12.9*x8 - 8*S7 - 2.6*mean7 + 1.1*M7 - 1.4), where M7,S7 = largest and second-largest of x0..x7 and mean7 their mean; large when x8 is the maximum or runner-up of x0..x8.
x7 below the running maximum of x0..x6 (about 2.4*shortfall), plus 4.3*x0's lead when x0 is the max, 2.2*x1's lead over x0..x7, 1.2*x8's margin over the third-largest; baseline 0.7.
Fires when x1 or x3 is among the two largest of x0..x8 (strongest when one of them is the largest), scaled up with the largest value of x0..x8.
By how much x8 sets a new running maximum: about 7.15*max(0, x8 - max(x0..x7)). Ignores x9.
Max-position code: lead of the largest of x2,x3,x4,x6,x7 over second-ranked values; zero when x5 is the maximum, and partly tracks how far x5 sits below the maximum.
Poorly understood position mix: on when x6 is the overall largest or x7 is second-largest of x0..x8; silenced when x8 is among the top two or x7/x8 is the largest.
Always on: weighted sum of the largest and second-largest of x0..x8 (about 3.3*max + 2.1*second), plus a small bump when the largest of x0..x8 is x1, x5 or x7.

Margin detector: (largest minus second-largest of x0..x8) weighted by the largest's position (strong at x0 and x5-x8, silent at x2-x3), plus (second minus third largest) weighted by second's position, plus third largest.
Weak detector that x8 is the largest of x2..x8 (a new recent record), scaled by x8's value and reduced by the second-largest of x0..x5.

x1 is the largest of x0..x8: about 14*(x1 minus the largest other of x0..x8, if positive) + 4.6*(x1's lead over the third-largest other value) + bonus if x1 is runner-up; plus 2.3*x0's lead when x0 is max.
How far x7 lies below a stored record, clipped at zero (zero when x7 is the largest): record is the largest value when the max sits at an even position, mostly the second-largest when odd.

Memory of the running maximum: about 12*max(x0..x8) + 20*max(x0..x7), plus a small boost from the total size of negative inputs; reduced by the margin (max minus second-largest) when the max is at x0, x2, x4 or x6.
How far x9 lies below the running maximum, about 13*(max - x9), clipped at zero; when the max sits at an odd position the max is blended with the second-largest value.
By how much x9 beats every earlier value: about 6.44*max(0, x9 - max(x0..x8)), i.e. x9 is the overall maximum.
Small detector that x8 is the maximum of x0..x8: about ReLU(17.1*x8 - 15.6*M - 0.74*T7 - 0.23*x9 - 0.18), i.e. 1.5*x8 minus small terms when x8 = M; M = max of x0..x8, T7 = third-largest of x0..x7.
How far x9 falls below the largest of x0..x8 (about 4.5 times the gap), shifted up when the max sits at x0,x5,x7 or x8 and down when it is at x1..x4 or x6.
Gap between the largest and second-largest of x0..x8, weighted heavily when that largest sits near x3 (x1..x5) and near zero/negative when it sits at x6..x7; plus a small second-largest-value term.
Delayed running maximum (mainly max of x0..x7, partly x8), minus a strong penalty proportional to x0+x7+x8 and a weak one for the other values.
Always-on, poorly understood: rises with total magnitude |x0|+..+|x6|, falls with the third-largest of x0..x8 and when x2, x4 or x5 is among the top two.
How far x9 falls below the second-largest of x0..x8: about 3*(second - x9) (+0.2*max), rectified; zero when x9 is among the two largest of all ten inputs.
Poorly understood, always on: roughly decreases with the sum of x0..x7 and increases with the three largest values of x0..x8.
Memory of the running maximum of x0..x8, plus how far x8 falls below the overall maximum, minus how far x9 falls below it, minus min(x4,x7) and min(x5,x6).
